name: au-private-rulings
description: Use this guide to prepare an Australian private ruling application under Division 359 of Schedule 1 to the Taxation Administration Act 1953, on the law at 2 November 2026 (the 2026-27 income year), for individuals, companies, trusts and super funds. Covers whether a private ruling fits, the scheme description and fact-to-document matrix, neutral yes-or-no questions, contentions, the ruling period and binding effect, the 60-day delay notice and objection, revised and inconsistent rulings and the route to object. Trigger on 'private ruling', 'private binding ruling', 'PBR', 'ATO ruling application', 'Division 359' or 'object to a private ruling'.
